description: Header file defining constants, data structures, and function prototypes for TunerStudio I/O communication in firmware. It includes protocol definitions, command codes, buffer configurations, and interface functions for serial communication with TunerStudio.

classes.name: ts_channel_s
classes.description: Data structure representing a TunerStudio communication channel, including a channel pointer, buffers for data transfer, and a read buffer for CRC validation.

methods.name: startTsPort
methods.description: Initializes and starts TunerStudio port communication over the specified channel.

methods.name: stopTsPort
methods.description: Stops the TunerStudio port communication for the specified channel.

methods.name: sr5WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the TunerStudio port.

methods.name: sr5WriteCrcPacket
methods.description: Sends a CRC-validated data packet over the TunerStudio port.

methods.name: sr5SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response over the TunerStudio port in specified format.

methods.name: sr5ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the TunerStudio port.

methods.name: sr5ReadDataTimeout
methods.description: Reads data with a timeout from the TunerStudio port.

methods.name: sr5IsReady
methods.description: Checks if the TunerStudio port interface is ready.
